title: Does not work in 5' x 8' bathroom
text: Does not work in 5' x 8' bathroom. I placed item in my 5' x 8' bathroom and let it run 5 hours. It had about 2 oz of water in the collector cup, and the wall tiles, shower curtain, and towels were still wet. It is quiet, but I think that's because it doesn't really work. I am returning it. Will just use rags to dry bathroom on humid days.
